rationale: This is the exact negation of the archived gen-3 "Cash-Flow Deficiency Among Innovators" (same two legs, same product form, with only IND_ZSCORE substituted for the raw level), so it re-tests an already-measured result and, worse, the product of a [0,1] rank with a signed z-score largely reduces to a cash-based operating profitability sort concentrated in R&D reporters — a well-documented published anomaly.

Substituting the five-year minimum for the mean is an economically motivated and internally consistent shift in which moment of the cash-flow distribution is priced, though TS_MIN(oancf/at) is highly correlated with its mean, so incremental content over the already-measured level interaction may be modest.

Conditioning the archive's strongest signal on cash profitability is a reasonable purification test, but the two legs are mechanically opposed — a high xrd/(oancf+xrd) burden is by construction a low-cash-flow state — so the product may shrink long-leg dispersion and partially undo the very strain mechanism it is meant to isolate; the hypothesis should acknowledge this tension rather than assert the alpha will rise above 5.2%.

The coverage-doubling motivation and the R&D-versus-acquired-intangible discrimination are legitimate, but structurally this is Signal 1 with the conditioning leg swapped, so it inherits the same risk of collapsing into a cash-based-profitability sort with an intangibility tilt rather than testing a genuinely new interaction.

Level-versus-change is the right open question and the asset-scaled differenced leg is a defensible re-test of the failed gen-1 trend variants, but two prior archive results (the R&D-scaled cash-yield trend and the widening funding gap) both leaned the wrong way for a positive prior, so the expected sign is asserted more confidently than the evidence warrants.

Substituting a lifetime stock measure for flow quality is a substantively different conditioning variable with much better coverage, but re/at is essentially cumulative profitability (and a known value/life-cycle proxy), so it is likely strongly collinear with the flow-based version and its result may not discriminate "track record" from current funding capacity.
